verdict.rationale: Airweave provides semantic search over synced data sources (collections, source connections) and an MCP server/CLI for agents to query that data, which could theoretically be repurposed to persist and recall session context, but there is no evidence of a dedicated 'add memory from conversation' API or conversation-turn ingestion feature — its connectors are built for apps/databases (Slack, GitHub, Airtable, etc.), not raw chat memory. missing for 10: explicit conversation-memory ingestion API, evidence of session-context write/read cycle, first-party or community proof of using it as a conversational memory store.
